_what_this_is: Grading wave 3. A LATER dated measurement of specific code units, which supersedes an earlier wave's grade for the SAME unit. Every PROVEN row here names the test that pins it AND the sabotage that proved the test can fail; a row without both is not a grade and scripts/capability_status.py must not read it as one.
_why_supersession_is_allowed: Rule 2 of the status ledger is fail closed: any source saying DEFECT OPEN makes a unit FIX PENDING. Applied across dates that rule is a trap, because it means no defect can ever be closed: the 2026-09-18 record would keep a unit red forever, however thoroughly it was later fixed. Resolution: the LATEST dated measurement wins for a unit, and within one date fail closed still applies. That is only sound because a later grade has to carry the same evidence an earlier one did, which is why `sabotage` is a required field here and not a note.
